## DISSEMINATED MYCOBACTERIUM AVIUM DISEASE TREATMENT
Many of these patients have HIV/AIDS. Management is complex. Consult
Infectious Diseases.
Rifabutin is optional for disseminated disease. Rifabutin can improve cure
rates, but may decrease blood concentrations of many drugs. Consult Infectious
Diseases or Pharmacy for more information.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Treatment is continued for 12 months and until CD4 count is >100 cells per
microliter for at least 6 months.
## Two-drug treatment
Preferred treatment
## Inpatient

Clarithromycin 500 mg PO q12h ($) [R,DI] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h
($$) [R]
Alternative
Azithromycin 250 mg PO q24h ($) [M] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h [R]
## Three-drug treatment
Preferred treatment
Clarithromycin 500 mg PO q12h($) [R,DI] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h
($$) [R] <AND> rifabutin 300 mg PO q24h ($$) [R,DI]
Alternative
Azithromycin 250 mg PO q24h ($) M <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO q24h [R]
<AND> rifabutin 300 mg q24h ($$) [R,DI]
## Outpatient

Clarithromycin 500 mg PO BID ($) [R,DI] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO QDay
($$) [R]
Non-VA order for above
Alternative
Azithromycin 250 mg PO QDay ($) [M] <AND> ethambutol 15 mg/kg PO QDay [R]
Non-VA order for above
## Three-drug treatment

Non-VA order for above
Alternative

Non-VA order for above
